properties.description: Six tests on start_registry with two designs: a session on A with readable_graph_ids [A,B] compares and composes against B by graph_id; without B in the set, refused naming B and revealing nothing; without the _meta, refused; A's own id refused; a path on a registry server refused (the hole); A→B and B→A concurrently without deadlock. Five wire tests failed on the unchanged binary, one of them showing the hole live.
